title: I Found The Source of the Coronavirus
summary: A 2020 video by laowhy86 arguing that the coronavirus did not originate outside China, pointing to evidence about the Wuhan institute and a possible patient zero. It cites sources in the description.
why: Frequently posted in early COVID origin and lab-leak threads as a compelling early case, though other commenters cite rebuttals and note it is speculative.

quote.text: I wish more people would watch this [0], might not be true but damn does it seem convincing.
